- Lightweight quantization and model-variant suggestions for cost savings
- Short troubleshooting if you saw any slow tail latency spikes

Three windows I have open (all PT):
- Fri 6/21, 10:00–10:20
- Fri 6/21, 13:00–13:20
- Mon 6/24, 09:30–09:50

If none work, send a couple of preferred slots and I’ll sync. I’ve attached a one-pager agenda to keep it focused. If helpful, I can loop in Ben for any model-level tuning items.
